Excuse me, Coach. I can't find my black bag.
A black bag? Is it in the game room?
No, it isn't. I look on the table and under the chair, and it is not there.
Then go to the lost and found box. It is in the main hall, next to the door.
Where is the main hall? I am new here.
Between the kitchen and the big window. You can't miss it.
Thank you. Is my key a problem? It is in the bag.
No problem. Nobody opens the box alone. Talk to me and we open it together.
I can't find my bag.
My key is in my bag.
It is on the table, next to the window.
Where is the lost and found?
It is between the door and the kitchen.

Hello, this is Coach Parker. I have a message for room two. Somebody left a black bag in the game room this morning. The bag is now in my office. My office is between the game room and the kitchen, and the door is always open. Inside the bag there is a book, a small towel and a phone. The phone is under the towel. Please come before five o'clock, because the office closes at five. Thank you.

Hi, this is Tyler. Listen, I need your help. I can't find my key. I look on the table, and it is not there. I look under the bed, and it is not there. I look in my bag, and it is not there. My mother always says the same thing: the key is never lost, you are. Ha. So please, if you see a small silver key next to the window or on a chair in room two, send me a message. Thank you, my friend.
Bruno looks for his bag in the game room. He does not find it on the table. He goes to the lost and found box in the main hall. He finds the bag next to the door. He says thank you to the coach.
